name: Changing a reportee's role notifies their reporting manager
description:
Objective: Changing a reportee's role notifies their reporting manager.
Preconditions: Open User lifecycle emails with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open User lifecycle emails.
2. Changing a reportee's role notifies their reporting manager.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: When a reportee's role is changed, their reporting manager must receive a REPORTEE_ROLE_UPDATED email in the configured app.

    assert_external_delivery_ready()

    raise AssertionError("External-delivery release gate failed:\n- " + "\n- ".join(problems))
